svg.title: push.register: permission to native token
svg.desc: The 30-second boundary covers permission, listeners and registration events. Denial, timeout, cancellation or close cleans up known and late handles. Success requires a real registration event and successful listener cleanup. Cleanup failure also returns failure; close can retry cleanup. The application must still associate the token with the account on its server.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
